name: toe_templates
title: TO&E templates (data/toe_templates.csv)
description: Hand-maintained. One row per official authorized table: one issuing nationality, one formation type, one echelon, one edition. Modelled on ship_classes.csv, with edition dates. Template ids TT0001 onward are never reused or renumbered. Authorized figures live here, not on claims.

fields.name: template_id
fields.description: Stable id, TT0001 onward. Never reused or renumbered.

fields.name: template_name
fields.description: Readable name as cited, e.g. US Infantry Division, T/O&E 7, 15 July 1943. Unique per nationality.

fields.name: nationality
fields.description: Issuing nation (data/nationalities.csv name). May differ from a using unit's nationality (a Canadian division on a British War Establishment), the same convention as ship_classes.nationality versus a ship's flag.

fields.name: domain
fields.description: Domain of the formation the table describes (vocabulary domain). v1 seed is ground.

fields.name: echelon
fields.description: Echelon the table describes (vocabulary echelon). v1 seed is almost entirely division.

fields.name: formation_type
fields.description: Type of formation the table describes (vocabulary formation_type). Not a column of units.csv.

fields.name: official_designation
fields.description: The table's own name: T/O&E 7, T/O 17, Infantry Division, 1944 Type, and so on.

fields.name: edition_date
fields.description: Official date of this edition (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM) when the source gives one.

fields.name: valid_from
fields.description: First day this edition is treated as in force, YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: valid_to
fields.description: Last day in force, inclusive. Blank if no superseding edition is recorded (see valid_to_basis).

fields.name: valid_to_basis
fields.description: Where valid_to comes from (vocabulary relation_end_basis). Use open when valid_to is blank.

fields.name: parent_template_id
fields.description: For a documented variant of a stock table. A parent is itself not a variant. Blank for a stock edition or a sibling table (the 1942 heavy US armored division is a sibling of the 1943 light table, not a child).

fields.name: authorized_strength_json
fields.description: JSON object of high-level authorized counts. Schema: schema/json/authorized_strength_json.schema.json. personnel is the authorized whole-unit total when the official table gives one; counts and structure use the authorized_count_key and authorized_structure_key vocabularies; a key is omitted when the source does not give it.

fields.name: structure_summary
fields.description: Short prose summary of the authorized subordinate structure. Not a list of unit ids, and not a substitute for command_relations.

fields.name: reference_ids
fields.description: Semicolon-separated data/references_meta.csv ids. The official table itself must be among them.

fields.name: template_note
fields.description: What the row does not cover, known local modifications, or why a variant exists. No figure that a reference does not give.
